name: splash-prerequisites.txt
command:
date -u
for k in db/appfw/home_appid memory/appfw/is_root_app_init_mode_fg db/menu/smart_hub/ontvsetting/auto_start; do vconftool get "$k"; done
for p in /opt/usr/apps/MiniHub001.Hub/shared/res/homeloading.edj /opt/usr/apps/MiniHub001/shared/res/homeloading.edj /usr/apps/MiniHub001.Hub/shared/res/homeloading.edj /opt/usr/apps/com.samsung.tv.csfs/shared/res/homeloading.edj /usr/apps/com.samsung.tv.csfs/shared/res/homeloading.edj /etc/app-boot-manager/res/edj/empty_loading.edj /opt/usr/apps/bstr_csfs_mode /tmp/boot_splash_resumed /tmp/.boot_splashscreen_run /tmp/boot_splash_finished; do if test -e "$p"; then ls -ldZ "$p"; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi; done
ls -ld /opt/usr/apps/MiniHub001* /usr/apps/MiniHub001* 2>/dev/null
find /opt/usr/share/crash /opt/var/log /var/log -maxdepth 2 -iname '*splash*' -print 2>/dev/null
true
